## Role in the Model

This page owns the inventory of power-conversion equipment between the turbine
generator and the PEM stack DC terminals. For each equipment role it records the
duty, voltage and insulation class, documented unit ratings, the unit count
implied by the article reference case, cost evidence and its price basis, losses,
package boundary and adoption status.

Other pages apply this inventory rather than repeat it.
[DC Integration](../hydrogen_production/dc_integration.qmd) defines the
turbine-level electrical cases,
[Electrolyser Power Electronics](../hydrogen_production/elx_power_electronics.qmd)
books the central transformer–rectifier package,
[Wind Turbine Mass and Cost](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd) owns the
turbine removal credit, and [Component Mapping](../architectures/component_mapping.qmd)
records which roles each architecture uses.

**Candidate evidence on this page is not an adopted model input.** A value enters
`model_data/inputs.csv` only after its scope, price basis and applicability are
adopted on the owning page. Unsupported values stay as explicit TODOs.

## Electrical Chains Compared

Three article cases are compared. All start at the same generator output, the
boundary of the [common operating case](../research_articles/turbine_level_hydrogen/reference_case.qmd#sec-common-operating-case).

| Equipment role | Centralised hydrogen | Conservative turbine-level | Direct DC (`converter_reduced`) |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Generator-side converter (rectifier) and DC link | Common baseline | Common baseline | Common baseline |
| Grid-side inverter | Used | Removed | Removed |
| Turbine step-up transformer | Used | Removed | Removed |
| 66 kV AC collection | Used ([Infield AC Cables](infield_ac_cables.qmd)) | Not used | Not used |
| Central step-down transformer | Used | Not used | Not used |
| Rectifier transformer | Used | Not used | Not used |
| Electrolyser rectifier | Used | Not used | Not used |
| Dedicated stack-side DC/DC converter | Not used | Used | Omitted, conditional on electrical matching and protection |

: Equipment roles in the three compared electrical chains.

```text
Centralised:   generator -> generator-side converter -> DC link -> grid-side inverter
               -> turbine transformer -> 66 kV collection -> central step-down transformer
               -> rectifier transformer -> rectifier -> stacks
Conservative:  generator -> generator-side converter -> DC link -> stack-side DC/DC -> stacks
Direct DC:     generator -> generator-side converter -> DC link -> stacks
```

The generator-side converter is present in every case. It is therefore
**excluded from the comparison cost table** and stays in the common turbine
baseline. Its losses still apply to every case and must be accounted for
consistently (see [Losses](#sec-pce-losses)). Auxiliary supplies, protection,
switchgear and dedicated cooling are named separately in each role below, so
that a package boundary cannot silently absorb or drop them.

## Reference-Case Unit Counts

The article case has {{< var ijv-turbine-count >}} turbines of
{{< var ijv-rated-power-mw >}} MW ({{< var ijv-installed-mw >}} MW). Counts per
turbine follow from the chains above; central counts depend on a selected unit
size, which is not yet chosen.

| Role | Count | Unit duty | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Grid-side inverter | one per turbine (centralised only) | turbine rating | Follows the turbine; no choice required |
| Turbine step-up transformer | one per turbine (centralised only) | turbine rating | Follows the turbine; MVA margin TODO |
| Central step-down transformer | $\lceil P_{\mathrm{served}}/S_{\mathrm{unit}}\rceil$ | selected unit size $S_{\mathrm{unit}}$ | TODO: select $S_{\mathrm{unit}}$ within documented limits (O3 platform layout) |
| Rectifier transformer and rectifier | one set per rectifier block | selected block size | TODO: block size follows stack module grouping and DC voltage |
| Stack-side DC/DC converter | one or more per turbine (conservative only) | turbine rating in parallel modules | TODO: module size within documented product limits |

: Unit counts for the reference case.

A product limit is a documented maximum; a model unit size is a selected design
input. The inventory keeps them separate: a published limit does not select the
unit size, and a selected size must stay within some documented limit.

## Equipment Inventory

### Generator-side converter (common baseline)

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | Controls generator current and torque; rectifies the generator output onto the turbine DC link |
| Voltage | IEA 15 MW generator: 4.77 kV line voltage at rating [@gaertner2020IEA15]. The converter voltage level is not defined by the reference turbine; the turbine case's converter voltage remains TODO |
| Documented ratings | Complete back-to-back medium-voltage converters to about 12 MW per line at 3.3 kV, and 20 MW and above with two lines [@abb2023PCS6000; @abbPCS6000Web2026] |
| Cost | In the common turbine baseline; not in the comparison table |
| Losses | Not separately published; the complete back-to-back converter is about 98% efficient at rated power [@abb2023PCS6000]. Not yet represented in the model (see [Losses](#sec-pce-losses)) |
| Status | Common baseline; loss share unresolved |

### Grid-side inverter

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | Converts the DC link to grid-frequency AC for the turbine transformer |
| Voltage | Same converter voltage as above; TODO |
| Documented ratings | Supplied as the grid half of a complete back-to-back package, not as a separate product [@abb2023PCS6000] |
| Cost evidence | No public source prices it separately. Complete-package references only: power converter 5.01% of turbine cost in a 2007 EWEA breakdown [@irena2012WindCost]; a complete power take-off (converter, transformer, switchgear and cabling) of about GBP 700,000 for a 10 MW turbine [@bvg2019OffshoreGuide] |
| Losses | No separate public value; complete-package efficiency about 98% [@abb2023PCS6000] |
| Package boundary | Inside the turbine converter package and inside the calibrated turbine cost |
| Status | **Evidence gap.** Neither cost nor losses are inferred by splitting a complete converter package; no removal credit is claimed until separable evidence exists |

### Turbine step-up transformer

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | Converter AC voltage to the 66 kV array voltage |
| Primary voltage | 66 kV array side; insulation class $U_m=72.5$ kV [@hitachiWindSTAR2026] |
| Secondary voltage and class | Converter AC voltage, reported in the range 0.69–3.3 kV [@bvg2019OffshoreGuide]; TODO with the converter voltage |
| Documented ratings | Tower or nacelle units above 7 MVA in 36 and 72.5 kV classes, ester insulated [@hitachiWindSTAR2026]; dry cast-resin designs are also used [@bvg2019OffshoreGuide] |
| Mass and cost evidence | WISDEM mass $1.915P+1910$ kg with $P$ in kW, and a 18.8 USD/kg reference rate, are already in the turbine ledger [@wisdemSource2026]; 3.59% of turbine cost in the 2007 EWEA breakdown [@irena2012WindCost] |
| Losses | No adopted value. EU Ecodesign loss limits do not apply to transformers for offshore wind turbines [@eu2019Ecodesign1783] |
| Package boundary | Transformer only; turbine switchgear and HV cabling are separate turbine electrical items |
| Status | Removal credit follows the explicit WISDEM transformer term (see [Wind Turbine Mass and Cost](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd)); losses TODO |

### Central step-down transformer

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | 66 kV collection voltage to the electrolyser plant's medium-voltage distribution |
| Primary voltage | 66 kV; $U_m=72.5$ kV |
| Secondary voltage and class | Plant medium voltage not selected; TODO |
| Documented ratings | ORBIT sizes offshore main power transformers at up to about 250 MW each [@orbitSource2026]; this applies to export-voltage transformers, not to this voltage pair |
| Cost evidence | Fraunhofer adds a separate high-voltage transformer of about 25–26 EUR/kW in its 100 MW electrolysis cases [@holst2021ElectrolysisCost]. ORBIT's main-transformer rate is 15,772 USD~2024~/MW of transformer rating, CPI-inflated, for a different voltage class [@orbitSource2026] |
| Losses | Fraunhofer assumes 99% efficiency for its high-voltage transformer [@holst2021ElectrolysisCost]. EU Ecodesign loss limits do not apply to offshore-platform transformers [@eu2019Ecodesign1783] |
| Package boundary | Within the central 185 EUR/kW package on [Electrolyser Power Electronics](../hydrogen_production/elx_power_electronics.qmd); must not be booked again on the platform |
| Status | Candidate evidence; booked through the central package |

### Rectifier transformer

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | Plant medium voltage to the rectifier valve-side voltage, with phase shifting for multi-pulse operation |
| Primary voltage | Plant medium voltage; TODO |
| Secondary voltage | Valve-side AC matching the stack DC voltage, which is not yet defined (stack cell count and grouping TODO). Rectifier transformers are documented for DC outputs up to about 2,000 V [@hitachiRectifierTransformers2026] |
| Documented ratings | Up to about 160 MVA per single tank [@hitachiRectifierTransformers2026]; a recent hydrogen supply used 13.3 MVA dry-type units, each feeding two 5 MW rectifiers [@hitachiKKWind2025] |
| Cost and losses | Not published separately from the transformer–rectifier package; package evidence below |
| Status | Booked inside the central package |

### Electrolyser rectifier

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | Controlled DC supply to the stack group |
| DC side | Stack DC voltage TODO; up to about 6 kA per water-cooled thyristor unit, scalable to about 25 kA [@abbUnirecWeb2026] |
| Documented ratings | Thyristor units by current as above; IGBT supplies up to 10 MW and above at up to 1,000 V DC [@abbHyQ2026] |
| Cost evidence | Transformer plus rectifier: 199 USD~2020~/kW manufactured cost for 1 MW [@badgett2024PEMCost]; about 160 EUR/kW power electronics plus 25–26 EUR/kW transformer at 100 MW [@holst2021ElectrolysisCost]; lower Chinese-market package prices [@gao2025AdvancedRectifiers] |
| Losses | Rectifier up to 99.6% [@abbUnirecWeb2026]; transformer plus rectifier above about 97.5% [@gao2025AdvancedRectifiers]; IGBT supply above 98% [@abbHyQ2026] |
| Status | The central package of 185 EUR/kW and 97.5% net efficiency is documented on [Electrolyser Power Electronics](../hydrogen_production/elx_power_electronics.qmd). Its efficiency is adopted; its unit cost is not yet normalised to EUR~2025~ (`central-conversion-unit-cost` blank) |

### Dedicated stack-side DC/DC converter (conservative case)

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Duty | Adapts the turbine DC-link voltage to the stack voltage, controls stack current and can provide isolation |
| Voltage | Input: turbine DC link, TODO with the converter voltage. Output: stack DC voltage, TODO |
| Documented ratings | No public multi-megawatt DC/DC product rating was confirmed; IGBT electrolyser supplies reach 10 MW and above [@abbHyQ2026] |
| Cost evidence | None found for a standalone DC/DC stage at this scale. A diode rectifier plus chopper system is reported at CNY 320/kW, including the rectifier [@gao2025AdvancedRectifiers]; it is not a DC/DC-only price |
| Losses | Vendor efficiency above 97.5% over the load range [@sungrowDCDC2026]; above 98% for comparable IGBT supplies [@abbHyQ2026] |
| Status | **Evidence gap for cost and rating**; efficiency candidates only. `conservative-conversion-efficiency` and `conservative-conversion-unit-cost` stay blank |

## Losses {#sec-pce-losses}

The model's wind-power states are generator electrical output: the IEA 15 MW
curve includes generator efficiency but no converter or transformer loss. The
current implementation applies AC cable losses and then the central 97.5%
package; turbine-level cases use a single interface efficiency that is still
blank. The loss terms are therefore:

| Loss term | Cases | Current model treatment | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Generator-side converter | All | Not represented | TODO: add consistently to every case |
| Grid-side inverter | Centralised | Not represented | TODO: evidence gap; do not split a package efficiency |
| Turbine step-up transformer | Centralised | Not represented | TODO |
| 66 kV AC collection | Centralised | Calculated from cable resistance | AC resistance and power factor still to be adopted |
| Central transformers and rectifier | Centralised | 97.5% net package efficiency | Adopted |
| Stack-side DC/DC converter | Conservative | Blank interface efficiency | Candidates above 97.5% |
| Direct-DC interface | Direct DC | Blank interface efficiency | Should cover only DC-link, protection and cabling losses; no converter loss |

: Loss terms by case and their current treatment.

Omitting the turbine converter and transformer losses from the centralised chain
favours that case, while omitting the generator-side converter affects all cases
equally. O2c must close these terms before energy comparisons are reported. A
detailed loss calculation replaces a flat efficiency rather than being added to
it.

## Cost and Mass Reconciliation

Each electrical function is counted once:

- The common turbine calibration includes the complete conventional turbine
  electrical scope, including converter and transformer. The turbine-level cases
  adjust it through `turbine-electrical-cost-adjustment` on
  [Wind Turbine Mass and Cost](../turbine_system/wind_turbine.qmd).
- The transformer removal credit can follow the explicit WISDEM transformer term
  in that ledger. No grid-side inverter credit is claimed, because the calibrated
  cost has no separable converter term and no separable evidence exists.
- The stack-side DC/DC converter is booked through the turbine-level conversion
  unit cost on [DC Integration](../hydrogen_production/dc_integration.qmd), not in
  the turbine adjustment.
- The central transformers and rectifier are booked in the central package; the
  platform page carries their mass but not their cost.
- No mass or cost saving is assumed beyond these explicit terms. Equipment masses
  for the platform (O3) and turbine lifts (O8) remain inputs; the ABB converter
  catalogue gives about 6.2 t for a 10 MW converter as context only
  [@abb2023PCS6000].

## Evidence Gaps

| Gap | Effect | Route to closure |
|---|---|---|
| Separate grid-side inverter cost and losses | No removal credit; centralised loss understated | Supplier data for a split package, or a documented converter cost model |
| Converter AC voltage and turbine DC-link voltage | Transformer secondary and DC/DC input undefined | Select a converter voltage level for the reference turbine |
| Stack DC voltage and grouping | Rectifier, rectifier-transformer and DC/DC output undefined | Stack cell count and series/parallel grouping on [Stack](../hydrogen_production/stack.qmd) |
| DC/DC cost and multi-megawatt unit rating | Conservative case cannot be costed | Supplier quotation or published product data |
| Turbine transformer losses | Centralised losses incomplete | Supplier loss data at the selected rating |
| Central unit sizes | Central counts undefined | Platform layout (O3) within documented limits |
